task.ques: Browse the ESPN+ page from ESPN for a brief summary of what ESPN+ Tools is used for.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: ESPN+ Tools helps subscribers make informed decisions for fantasy teams and Tournament Challenge brackets. Its Bracket Predictor analyzes matchups and recommends picks one game at a time; its Bracket Analyzer estimates how many picks in a bracket will be correct and the bracket’s round-by-round survival odds.

Evidence: ESPN’s “ESPN Plus Tools” page, https://www.espn.com/espnplus/tools/ (viewed October 28, 2026). Screenshot: final.png.
